title: ARM templates and what Bicep fixes about them

videos.script: Every Azure resource is created by one API, Resource Manager. {{arm}} What it reads is a template, written in JSON. Brackets inside strings, functions inside brackets, and a list of dependencies you maintain by hand. {{json}} Bicep is a language that compiles to that JSON. Same resources, same API, fewer places to be wrong. {{bicep}} In this lesson you install Bicep, turn a JSON template into Bicep and back, and watch the compiler catch some mistakes and miss others. {{end}}
